facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹34,609 cr, +41% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹3,203 cr, +29% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹9,899 cr (+53% YoY), PAT ₹990 cr (+43% YoY), operating margin 14.4%.
Revenue has compounded at 19% over 10 years, 27% over 5 and 27% over 3; the last twelve months (+41%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (29% vs 27%).
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +46% → +27% → +39% → +53% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 14.4% (15.8% a year ago).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 10% to 14% over five years; the latest year (14%) sits at the top of that range.
Borrowings are ₹272 cr against equity of ₹13,094 cr: debt/equity 0.02× (was 0.03× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 15.7× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹1,401 cr, 35% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to 39 days from 65 in Mar 2023 (payable days 72 → 108, debtor days 32 → 48).
Promoters hold 61.4%, unchanged over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 18.1%, +4.1 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹8,856 cr of operating cash came from ₹12,576 cr of operating profit: 70% conversion; against PAT of ₹8,756 cr that is 1.0×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹4,592 cr, latest year ₹2,340 cr.
Capex ran at 5% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,471 cr (averaged 4% over the three years before).

claims.claim: The company has gained market share of around 1% to 1.5% every year, with 3% to 4% gain last year.

claims.quote: Notably, this marks the 11th consecutive quarter of industry leading growth

claims.claim: The company's working capital cycle reduced to approximately 11 days in Q2 FY27.

claims.quote: In last quarter, in fact, we updated that overall, we have gained 3% to 4% market share.

claims.claim: Domestic wires and cable organized market share increased to 30-31% from 18-19% in FY19.
claims.quote: Our domestic wires and cable organized market share has now increased to 30-31% up from 18- 19% in financial year 2019.

claims.claim: We do not have any inventory gains unlike peers because we hedge our raw material prices.
claims.quote: we have a hedging mechanism in place. So we don't have any inventory gain unlike peers.

claims.claim: Demand in the power sector can only defer by 1-3 weeks, it cannot extinguish.
claims.quote: the demand can only defer by 1 week, 2 weeks here and there. But if you look at 12-month period coming forward, I think not just the next 12 months, but I think 24-36 months are going to be very promising

claims.claim: The company took a strategic decision to pass on raw material price increases in a staggered manner to protect volumes and gain market share.
claims.quote: In order to avoid demand disruption, arising from elevated input costs, the Company took a strategic decision to pass on the increase in raw material prices in a staggered manner.

claims.claim: Domestic W&C volume growth was nearly 40% in Q3 FY26.
claims.quote: In volume, the domestic W&C business recorded nearly 40% growth, reflecting healthy underlying demand.

claims.claim: The company closed the quarter with a net cash position of ₹ 30.3 billion.
claims.quote: We continue to maintain a strong balance sheet, closing the quarter with a net cash position of ₹ 30.3 billion.

claims.claim: FMEG segment remained profitable for the fourth consecutive quarter.
claims.quote: Importantly, the FMEG segment remained profitable for the fourth consecutive quarter, even while strategically ramping up our A&P investments

claims.claim: The company saw its highest ever second quarter and half yearly revenue, reflecting strong demand and execution capability.
claims.quote: This quarter, we saw our highest ever second quarter and half yearly revenue, reflecting the strength in demand and that of our execution capability.

claims.claim: The company suggests market share gains in the domestic Wires & Cables segment during the quarter.
claims.quote: The continued momentum underscores our strengthened market position and suggests market share gains in the domestic segment during the quarter.

claims.claim: The company's EBITDA margin expansion was supported by strong profitability in the larger Wires & Cables business.
claims.quote: The margin expansion was supported by strong profitability in the larger Wires & Cables business.

claims.claim: The company's EPC segment margin of 18.1% included a one-time gain of approximately ₹ 300 million.
claims.quote: Segment's profitability stood at ₹ 730 million, translating to a margin of 18.1%. This includes a one-time gain of approximately ₹ 300 million

claims.claim: Q1 EBITDA margin expansion was driven by strategic pricing actions, operational efficiencies and a favorable business mix.
claims.quote: The margin expansion was driven by a combination of strategic pricing actions, operational efficiencies and a favorable business mix.

claims.claim: Polycab's market share in the organized cables and wires market was roughly 26% to 27% in FY25.
claims.quote: our market share in C&W put together was roughly about 26% to 27%. This is the organized market share.

claims.claim: The company is not witnessing any form of slowdown in the cables and wires business.
